candidate_attempt_rule: There are five candidate slots. Candidate 1 is the restored M68 V3 plan without a new model call. Candidates 2-5 may use at most one new real tactical CLI each. Contract or static failures retain the slot; only STARTED processes and simulations count against their applicable limits.
counting_rule: Count each real tactical CLI process and each fixed full-stage simulation at STARTED, including failures and timeouts. Stop immediately on an 8-ID WIN. No automatic retry, resume, replacement call, historical balance transfer, or sixth candidate. A pre-STARTED gate rejection without a model process does not count a CLI; a pre-reservation gate rejection without Simulator.run does not count a simulation.
non_stackable: M68 ended at CLI 3/3 and simulation 2/3; its unused simulation does not transfer. M52 V1 nine-operator WIN remains the frozen baseline until an M69 8-ID WIN is verified.
